proposal.reactor_type: 5 mL SS packed-bed reactor; catalyst packing status unconfirmed
proposal.residence_time_basis: Nominal liquid residence time calculated as stated 5.0 mL reactor volume divided by 0.050 mL/min liquid-feed rate. This is not a validated catalyst-bed residence time because catalyst packing and bed void fraction are unspecified.
proposal.light_setup: None; no light source is required or available.

streams.contents: N-Diphenylmethylazetidin-3-ol feed; source-protocol material, availability and solubility at this concentration must be confirmed

proposal.mixing_order_reasoning: Meter the liquid substrate solution and hydrogen independently into the certified gas-liquid mixer immediately upstream of the heated bed. This minimizes upstream hydrogen-containing liquid hold-up and uses the only certified mixer provided. The proposed hydrogen excess is deliberately large for a first gas-limited hydrogenolysis screen.
pre_reactor_steps: Do not run until a documented Pd(OH)2/Al2O3 catalyst charge or certified prepacked equivalent is added to the approved inventory.
Confirm that the 5 mL packed-bed reactor is correctly packed, retained with compatible frits, pressure-tested, and leak-tested with inert gas before hydrogen introduction.
Prepare and filter the 0.050 M methanolic substrate solution only after confirming methanol, substrate, and compatibility with the HPLC pump.
With an approved catalyst installed, establish 0.050 mL/min liquid flow, heat the reactor to 60 C, establish 10 bar BPR control, then introduce hydrogen at 5.0 sccm while checking for leaks.
post_reactor_steps: Route reactor effluent through a suitable contained gas-liquid separation/collection arrangement before any pressure letdown; such equipment is not listed and therefore this step cannot presently be implemented.

Do not vent hydrogen into the laboratory. On shutdown, stop hydrogen, purge using an approved inert-gas procedure if such gas and hardware are made available, cool, and depressurize through an approved controlled system.
Analyze collected liquid only after confirming that an appropriate collection and analytical workflow is available.
proposal.chemistry_notes: The source batch protocol used Pd(OH)2/Al2O3 at 60 C for 5 h and reported 38.1% isolated yield. Acetic acid is not included because it is not listed in the authoritative inventory. The proposed 0.050 M concentration is an explicitly conservative assumption, not a reported solubility value. One equivalent of H2 consumption is assumed only for estimating gas excess; actual hydrogen uptake and product selectivity require measurement.

stage_parameters.status: Blocked; values are conditional target settings, not an authorized run
stage_parameters.calculation_assumptions: H2 actual volumetric flow estimated at 60 C and 11 bara from 5.0 sccm referenced to 0 C and 1.013 bara. In-channel residence is 5.0 mL divided by the sum of 0.050 mL/min liquid and 0.56 mL/min pressure-corrected gas. It ignores catalyst-bed void fraction, gas dissolution, pressure gradient, and two-phase slip.

reasoning_per_field.temperature_C: Matches the source batch hydrogenolysis temperature and is below the 120 C reactor limit.
reasoning_per_field.BPR_bar: 10 bar(g) is the lowest available BPR setting and is within the required 10-20 bar range.
reasoning_per_field.flow_rate_mL_min: 0.050 mL/min exceeds the pump minimum of 0.010 mL/min and gives a long nominal liquid contact time for a conservative initial test.
reasoning_per_field.concentration_M: 0.050 M is a conservative assumed starting concentration; verify solubility and pumpability before use.
reasoning_per_field.hydrogen_flow: 5.0 sccm is within the certified MFC range of 0.1-100 sccm and supplies an estimated 89-fold excess relative to the assumed substrate feed and one-equivalent H2 demand.
reasoning_per_field.reactor_volume_and_residence: The stated 5.0 mL reactor and 0.050 mL/min liquid feed give 100 min nominal liquid residence time, but true catalyst-bed void residence cannot be assigned without packing information.
reasoning_per_field.block_reason: A catalytic hydrogenolysis requires a defined active Pd(OH)2/Al2O3 bed. No such catalyst or prepacked cartridge is in the authoritative inventory.

proposal.literature_analogies: The only directly supplied precedent is the source batch protocol: methanolic Pd(OH)2/Al2O3 hydrogenolysis at 60 C under hydrogen for 5 h. No external packed-bed literature analogy is asserted because catalyst loading, particle size, bed voidage, and continuous-flow performance are not provided.
safety_flags: BLOCKED: Pd(OH)2/Al2O3 catalyst or documented prepacked catalyst bed is absent from inventory.
BLOCKED: a post-reactor gas-liquid separation/contained collection arrangement is not listed.
Hydrogen is flammable; use only the certified H2 MFC, certified gas-liquid mixer, rated SS tubing, and approved leak-testing and ventilation procedures.
Never heat or introduce hydrogen before pressure integrity and leak testing are completed.
The 10 bar BPR target is below the 50 bar ratings stated for the H2 hardware, pump, and tubing, but all fittings and the fully assembled system require independent rating confirmation.
Acetic acid is excluded because it is not listed in inventory.
Do not infer catalyst presence merely from the phrase packed-bed reactor.
proposal.confidence: High confidence that the stated inventory is insufficient for execution; low confidence in any chemistry-performance prediction until catalyst identity, bed properties, feed solubility, and downstream containment are documented.
